reports.title: Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (recast)
reports.description: The EU's general Financial Regulation, third generation. Adopted as a recast of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046: 'A number of amendments are to be made to Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046 ... In the interests of clarity and legal certainty, that Regulation should be recast.' Article 279: 'Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046 is repealed.'
reports.cadence_note: Per C1's ruling ('acceptable modelling choice'), this lineage uses a uniform MFF-cycle cadence rather than a per-edition interval -- recasts track the EU's seven-year multiannual financial framework, not an independent publication schedule. Not stated as a number here; left to whoever imports this to apply the corpus's agreed MFF-cadence convention consistently across all five chains in this file.

reports.title: Regulation (EU) 2021/695 establishing Horizon Europe -- the Framework Programme for Research and Innovation
reports.description: Current EU research framework programme. Own title/recital: 'repealing Regulations (EU) No 1290/2013 and (EU) No 1291/2013' -- TWO predecessors repealed in the same act, not one. G.52.md's description named only the framework-programme lineage (1291/2013); this session's direct fetch found the second, a rules-of-participation sibling (see eu-horizon-2020-rules-participation). Modelled as one-to-many per D2's ruling, same shape as the CAP Strategic Plans Regulation.

_open_questions.question: Does NDICI (2021/947) repeal the other 2014-generation external-action instruments (DCI 233/2014, ENI 232/2014, EIDHR 235/2014, 230/2014, 234/2014, 236/2014, Euratom 237/2014)?
_open_questions.answer: NO -- confirmed by direct fetch of Article 50. Only 480/2009, 2017/1601 and 466/2014/EU are named as repealed. The other seven regulations appear only in a financial/transitional context ('the financial envelope for the Instrument may cover expenditure incurred under...'), which reads as their own 2014-2020 MFF terms lapsing on schedule, not as NDICI repealing them. Do NOT model a supersedes edge from eu-ndici-global-europe to DCI/ENI/EIDHR-class instruments -- it would misstate what the source text actually says. This closes C2 as a negative finding rather than a research gap.
